name: cordova-plugin-demos
description: Demo apps for different cordova plugins

paragraphs: A collection of source code for Apache Cordova plugin demo apps by Andrés Zsögön. Most directories provide the app's www and res folders, along with a config.xml file when required.
Most legacy demos bundle jQuery 3.6.0. Newer demos use plain JavaScript when no additional library is required.
